subject: mirejaw
disposition: Disabled asset-local candidate; production species selection unchanged

reference_prompt: Draft an original Tetherbound Mirejaw creature reference from the supplied established reference crops and the full view of its installed model. ONE clean full-body three-quarter studio view of the same stout aquatic salamander/axolotl beast: very broad rounded head, wide friendly jaw with pale cream lips and small simple ivory teeth, visible expressive dark amber eyes above the mouth, stocky charcoal/olive-grey body with tan reticulated pebble-like mottling, cream-grey throat and belly, four short sturdy amphibian legs with separated broad clawed/webbed toes, and a thick long tapering tail that ends in a compact gill/fin fan. Preserve its recognizable squat silhouette, massive smiling face, dark mottled skin and paired external cheek gills. Make the cheek gills into a few robust broad connected sculpted lobes branching directly from the head, not thin wiry stalks or floating wisps. Use muted natural ochre/amber-brown gill tissue; avoid faction oxblood/red paint, cloth or markings. Neutral grounded quadruped standing pose with distinct shoulders/elbows and hips/knees, four separated grounded feet, body straight, tail clearly separate and entirely in frame. Mouth only slightly open so the face remains solid and riggable, no enormous deep cavity or projecting tongue. Full body, tail and both gill fans inside the image with generous margin. Neutral light-grey studio background, soft lighting and a clean detailed stylized game-creature look, coherent broad materials instead of photorealistic reptile noise. No human, saddle, harness, clothing, equipment, text, ruler, particles, extra limbs, dramatic action, new horns or environment. This is the same current-roster Mirejaw, no new species.
